shelters.name: MSPCA-Angell
shelters.description: Founded 1868, second-oldest humane society in US. National leader in animal protection and veterinary medicine. 11,069 animals found homes in 2024. Leads coalition of MA welfare groups.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue League of Boston
shelters.description: Unwavering champion for animals in need, committed to keeping them safe and healthy in homes. Building new $48M facility in South End.

shelters.name: Second Chance Animal Services
shelters.description: Founded 1999, helped over 49,000 pets last year. Operates Community Veterinary Hospitals in North Brookfield, Southbridge, Springfield, and Worcester.

shelters.name: Worcester Animal Rescue League
shelters.description: Main resource for animals in need in Worcester, the second largest city in Massachusetts. Part of MSPCA coalition.

shelters.name: Dakin Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Pioneer Valley and Springfield area. Part of MSPCA coalition.

shelters.name: MSPCA Cape Cod Adoption Center
shelters.description: Animal resource and adoption center providing spay/neuter services, dog training, adoptions, and humane education for Cape Cod.

shelters.name: New England Society for Abandoned Animals
shelters.description: No-kill shelter serving 15 towns of Cape Cod. Programs focused on cats with services for dogs. Offers free/low-cost spay/neuter, vaccinations.

shelters.name: Berkshire Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Berkshires in Western Massachusetts. Part of MSPCA coalition.

shelters.name: Thomas J. O'Connor Animal Control and Adoption Center
shelters.description: Animal control and adoption center serving Springfield. Part of MSPCA coalition.

shelters.name: Boston Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: City of Boston animal control providing shelter and adoption services. Part of MSPCA coalition.

shelters.name: Lowell Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides shelter, prevents cruelty to animals, and advocates for their welfare in the Greater Lowell area.

shelters.name: Animal Protection Center of Southeastern Massachusetts
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal care and adoption facility serving southeastern Massachusetts. Since 2009, placed over 9,000 animals into forever homes.

shelters.name: Baypath Humane Society
shelters.description: Dedicated to providing shelter, care, humane treatment and loving homes for stray or unwanted companion animals.

shelters.name: Massachusetts Humane Society
shelters.description: Established 2004, celebrates 21 years of rescuing animals in need. Advocate for animal protection rights and welfare.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue Front
shelters.description: Located on Cape Cod, founded in September 2005 following Hurricane Katrina.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Massachusetts animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. MSPCA-Angell (founded 1868) is the second-oldest humane society in the US and leads a coalition of MA welfare groups. Second Chance Animal Services helped 49,000+ pets last year. Coverage spans Boston, Worcester, Springfield, Cape Cod, Berkshires, Lowell, and surrounding areas.
